PHASE 0 INVESTIGATION — design complete, 2026-05-16. Anthony chose collective propose-and-union initiation, closing invariant 1. Tool-calling enters the protocol as a new Phase 0 before Phase 1.

SHAPE: (1) each model INDEPENDENTLY receives the prompt and proposes an investigation set (tool calls it wants), no peer visibility during proposal — structurally identical to Phase 1 independence. (2) Proposals combined by RULE-BASED UNION with exact/structural dedup only — deterministic, not a model deciding — same spirit as rule-based Phase 4 synthesis. (3) Union executed, results land in the shared feed. (4) Feed FROZEN before Phase 1, mapping onto ARCHITECTURE.md §8 existing freeze discipline (Phase 1 outputs frozen, prompt re-anchored per phase). (5) Phase 1 proceeds: independent generation over prompt PLUS frozen shared feed, identical for all three. Every piece reuses an existing architectural pattern; this is the strong spec-amendment story — a new phase built entirely from moves the architecture already makes, not a new risky mechanism.

FOUR SUB-DECISIONS, RESOLVED (recommended, faithful to existing patterns):
- Dedup: exact/structural only, NEVER semantic-merge. Semantic merge needs an adjudicator → reintroduces the authority gradient just closed. Redundant tool calls are a cost, not an invariant violation.
- Cap: per-model proposal cap mirroring Phase 3's hard caps ('the constraint is the feature'). Protects the daily-driver cost profile (README: protocol already ~3x single Opus; unbounded tools blow that). Cap NUMBER is Anthony's knob, default proposal: 3 investigations per model.
- Empty: a model proposing zero investigations is valid; empty union → skip to Phase 1 with no feed, clean degenerate path (like dyad parity returning None is valid).
- Failure: a failed tool call is a typed FEED ENTRY all peers see ('tried, could not'), not a session abort — faithful to no-silent-failures and symmetric visibility. EXCEPT precondition failures (credit balance class) which remain the orchestrator-layer OrchestratorProviderError abort already chronicled. Distinction already exists in the architecture.

INVARIANT 4 consequence (required): Claim schema gains tool-provenance; irreducibility trace covers feed-grounded claims same as prior-grounded.

TUI consequence: feed is a panel in the shipped M1 renderer; trace ledger marks feed-grounded vs prior-grounded; parity panel can distinguish reasoned-convergence from same-evidence-convergence.

REMAINING: not a fork, a sequencing call for Anthony — amend ARCHITECTURE.md (add Phase 0, this is canonical, fifth phase) + build Phase 0 now, OR finish M1 live wire first then Phase 0. Plus the cap number. Status per CONTRIBUTING spec-amendment discipline: real need (daily-driver critical path) yes; structurally enforceable yes (Phase 0 as typed phase, rule-based union, freeze, tool-provenance Claim); tested — not yet; ARCHITECTURE.md amended — not yet; chronicled — this entry. Design complete, build pending.
